additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R2 312555359038
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
XGt5yY
Problem Description
: Outlet 3 out of order
Troubleshooting
:
The error is IMD_BC2
MB-Er:1 IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:0 Capa:2 RlyConn:1 Init:1 SIS:0
MB-Er: 1 - if no new data from IMD recieved within 5s via Modbus
Capa: 2 → maximum Y-capacity is exceeded at the DC output
Please make sure that the connections are okay from the Bus bar and the communication cables. Please check if there are any signs of water inside the charger that might be dropping the resistance value.
Please take a spare IMD to site for possible replacement.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0386894
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
